text: dsh-plugin-market 是一个面向 DSH Web 的插件市场入口插件。它通过设置侧边栏的 settings.section 注册 Plugin Market 项，点击后会在新标签页打开 dshmarket.com。它提供侧边栏入口和外部市场跳转，适合只想从 DSH 设置快速进入社区插件市场的用户；该插件本身没有实现市场浏览、搜索或一键安装功能。使用时需要能够访问 dshmarket.com，不要求配置 API Key 或账号。

dsh-plugin-market adds a Plugin Market link to the DSH Web settings sidebar. Clicking it opens dshmarket.com in a new tab. The plugin provides quick access to the community market, but no browsing or installation features. Users need access to dshmarket.com; no API key or account is required.
想在 DSH Web 设置里加个入口，点一下就能打开社区插件市场。
有没有办法从设置侧边栏快速跳到 DSH 插件市场？
I want a shortcut in the DSH Web settings that opens the community plugin market.
dsh-plugin-market 的功能「打开插件市场」：在 DSH Web 设置侧边栏显示 Plugin Market 项。用户点击后，浏览器会在新标签页打开 dshmarket.com。
dsh-plugin-market 点击入口会打开外部站点 dshmarket.com；跳转地址固定在客户端代码中，未附加用户输入参数。

dsh-plugin-market README · dsh-plugin-market：Adds a **Plugin Market** entry to the DSH settings sidebar that opens
[dshmarket.com](https://dshmarket.com/) — the community plugin market for
DeepSeek Harness — in a new tab.

For most people this plugin is unnecessary: installing the market itself

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket
```

puts a full browse / search / one-click-install market inside the settings
page. This plugin is the light-weight alternative for people who want a button
and nothing else.

dsh-plugin-market README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:changan0617/dsh-plugin-market
```

Restart `dsh web`. The entry appears in the settings sidebar next to the
built-in Plugins page.

dsh-plugin-market README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-market
```
